task: Open /home/user/Documents/photo.kra in Krita. It is currently 1920x1080. Scale the entire image (canvas + contents) down to 1280x720 using a high-quality interpolation filter. Then export the scaled image to /home/user/Pictures/photo_web.jpg as a JPEG. Save the .kra file in place so /home/user/Documents/photo.kra itself is also 1280x720 after the task.

cli_feasibility.translation: Resize image to 1280x720 and export to JPEG
cli_feasibility.reason: ✅ CLI supports canvas resize and export render to JPEG
